Title: Acta Ecclesiae Mediolanensis (a Carolo cardinali S.
  Praxedis archiepiscopo condita, Federici card. Borromaei
  archiepiscopi Mediolani iussu undique diligentius collecta et
  edita)
Creator: Archdiocese of Milan (Carlo Borromeo's and Federico
  Borromeo's own provincial councils, synodal decrees, and
  pastoral instructions)
Publisher: 1599 printing (first published 1582)
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: Published 1599; public domain by date. Archive.org
  item metadata carries no explicit possible-copyright-status tag but
  shows access-restricted-item: None (freely downloadable), checked
  directly against the item's own metadata, 2026-09-25, this
  session; pd-us-by-date applies independently given the 1599
  publication date.
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item actaecclesiaemed01cath
  (archive.org/details/actaecclesiaemed01cath), fetched directly
  (curl, raw bytes) from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file,
  2026-09-25, this session.
Provenance note: Body text unaltered including its own OCR errors
  (Latin). Contains Borromeo's own Instructiones Fabricae et
  Supellectilis Ecclesiasticae in its original Latin, among other
  Milan synodal acts - no PD English translation of either exists.
  This is Borromeo's own institutional voice, previously wholly
  unvendored in any form. Vendored 2026-09-25 as part of a
  post-Step0-Revision-2 PD source-acquisition pass. Per this
  project's own INTAKE.md rule, this Latin text is a second
  witness, never primary evidence for a Representative.
